records.text: But on Mount Zion there will be salvation, and it will be holy; the house of Jacob will possess those who possessed them.

The house of Jacob will be a fire, the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau stubble. They will blaze against them and consume them, and there will be no bearer of fire in the house of Esau, because the Lord has spoken.

Those in the Negeb will possess the mountain of Esau, and those in the Shephelah will possess the foreigners. They will possess the mountain of Ephraim, the plain of Samaria, Benjamin and the land of Gilead.

And this is the beginning of the deportation: for the sons of Israel, the land of the Canaanites as far as Zarephath; and the deportation of Jerusalem as far as Ephrathah. They will inherit the cities of the Negeb.
And men who have been saved shall ascend from Mount Zion to execute judgment upon the mountain of Esau; and the kingdom shall be the Lord’s.
For thus says the Lord: Does one who falls not rise? Or does one who turns away not return?
Why has this people of Mine turned away with a shameless turning away, and been held fast in their own choice, and been unwilling to return?
Give ear now and hear: they will not speak thus; there is no person repenting of his evil, saying, ‘What have I done?’ The runner ceased from his course like a sweating horse in its neighing.
Even the stork in heaven knew her time; turtledove and swallow, field sparrows, kept the times of their coming, but My people did not know the Lord’s judgments.
How will you say, ‘We are wise, and the Lord’s law is with us’? A false reed-pen came to be in vain for scribes.
The wise were ashamed and terrified and captured, because they rejected the Lord’s word. What wisdom is in them?
Therefore I will give their wives to others and their fields to inheritors,
Humbled and unsettled woman, you were not comforted! Behold, I am preparing carbuncle as your stone and sapphire as your foundations,
and I will make your battlements jasper, your gates crystal stones, and your enclosing wall choice stones,
On that day the Lord will again show His hand, to be zealous for the remaining remnant of the people left from the Assyrians, Egypt, Babylonia, Ethiopia, the Elamites, the sun’s rising and Arabia.
He will raise a signal to the nations and gather Israel’s lost ones; He will gather Judah’s scattered ones from the earth’s four wings.
